title: CHAOS-3860 P6 panel run manifest (v1)
description: HARNESS-OWNED schema (see docs/design/context-fabric-panel-run-manifest.md): the immutable, machine-readable artifact internal/panelharness.Run produces per (org, question) activation. NOT a product wire contract -- it never enters contracts/ and is not subject to the contract-first rule, mirroring testdata/fullstack/v1's own context_fabric_agent_result.v1.schema.json precedent exactly (ACR does not consume this; a future, separately-ratified P5 annotator does).

question_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonicalized question (contextfabric.QuestionHash) -- the raw question text is NEVER carried by this artifact.

clarification_logs.description: CHAOS-4146(a): one entry per panelist that attempted at least one Investigate call, its own turn-by-turn clarification-loop history. Optional and additive -- absent on a manifest written before this field existed.

case_index.description: CHAOS-4146(c), schema v2: 0-based corpus case index (cmd/acr-panel-harness -corpus batch mode). Index only, never the case's question text. Absent for a single ad-hoc (-question) run.

run_tag.description: CHAOS-4146(c), schema v2: groups every manifest one batch invocation writes (mirrors scripts/trial's own RUN_TAG discipline). Absent for a single ad-hoc run.

corpus_path.description: CHAOS-4146(c), schema v2: path to the corpus file that drove a batch run -- path only, never the corpus's own content. Absent for a single ad-hoc run.

corpus_sha256.description: CHAOS-4146(c), schema v2: SHA-256 hex digest of the corpus file's raw bytes, proving it was not silently swapped mid-batch. Absent for a single ad-hoc run.

member.description: window is out of this harness's scope -- it rides its own, separately designed WindowSelectionEvent path.

complete.description: true only when EVERY configured panelist produced a landed (applied, not vetoed) selection for this member -- the sol-max ruling's required invariant, part 1.

distinct_identities.description: true only when every panelist's canonical_model_identity is unique -- the required invariant, part 2.

case_index.description: CHAOS-4146(c), schema v2: mirrors the enclosing manifest's own case_index, denormalized onto every member row. Absent for a single ad-hoc run.

agreement_bits.description: parallel to the enclosing panel_member_run's own panelists array -- agreement_bits[i] reports whether panelists[i].applied_value equals majority_value. Reported data only; this artifact never itself claims a promotion decision (that rule is P5/curation's own, separately-ratified authority threshold).
